videos.headline: Devon Dampier runs it in to put Utah on the board early
Braden Pegan breaks free for a 46-yard Utes touchdown
Bear Bachmeier airs it out deep to Legend Glasker for a 75-yard BYU TD
LJ Martin puts BYU up with a TD run
QB Devon Dampier makes great catch on Utah's 4th-down trick play
Devon Dampier throws 14-yard TD pass to Braden Pegan
Devon Dampier rushes in for 3-yard TD
Trey Reynolds picks off BYU Cougars
